identity_key_note: entity_id added 2026-08-09 (canon-identity-key-unification). mobile_asset records historically keyed identity as canonical_id while the other 166 canon records use entity_id, so any tool indexing only entity_id silently skipped every vessel. commanding_intelligence_designation.identity_status: UNDETERMINED — probable designation of the same intelligence, not merged
commanding_intelligence_designation.reasoning: Canon records nemesis_core (aliases: Nemesis Core, The Nemesis) as commanding officer of the Nemesis Prime. The archive names WRATH-09 in the same office aboard the same vessel, so it is most plausibly an earlier or alternate designation — historical naming churn. It is recorded here verbatim rather than added as an alias, because merging two AI identities on a plausible inference is not a reconciliation. Resolve via the naming gate (queued: wrath-09-naming-gate).
